section_header: REAR AXLE AND SUSPENSION — IRS Type Differential
title: REAR AXLE AND SUSPENSION — IRS Type Differential

content.description: Illustration showing differential case with bearing outer races and ring gear being installed in carrier

items: (a) Place the bearing outer races on their respective bearings. Make sure the left and right outer races are not interchanged.
(b) Install the differential case in the carrier.

content.description: Illustration showing installation of plate washer on ring gear back side

content.text: (a) Install only the plate washer on the ring gear back side.
NOTE: Insure that the ring gear has a backlash.

content.description: Illustration showing snugging down washer and bearing by tapping on ring gear with plastic hammer

content.text: (b) Snug down the washer and bearing by tapping on the ring gear with a plastic hammer.

content.description: Illustration showing holding side bearing boss on teeth surface of ring gear and measuring backlash with dial indicator

content.text: (c) Hold the side bearing boss on the teeth surface of the ring gear and measure the backlash.

content.description: Illustration showing installation of ring gear back plate washer

content.text: (d) Select a ring gear back plate washer using the backlash as reference. (See page RA-32)
